[SWS_CanTSyn_91003] Definition of API function CanTSyn_IcvVerificationIndi-
cation
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_20073
⌈
Service Name
CanTSyn_IcvVerificationIndication
Syntax
void CanTSyn_IcvVerificationIndication (
uint32 jobId,
Crypto_ResultType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x08
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
jobId
JobID of the operation that caused the callback.
Parameters (in)
result
Contains the result of the cryptographic operation.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
By this API service the CanTSyn gets an indication and the result of ICV verification.
Available via
CanTSyn.h
⌋
[SWS_CanTSyn_00203]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323, SRS_BSW_00337
⌈The function CanTSyn_IcvVerificationIndication() shall inform the DET, if development
error detection is enabled (CanTSynDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE) and if function
call has failed because of the following reasons:
• jobId is invalid (CANTSYN_E_PARAM)
